# Firebase helper

When the user works with Firebase, prefer the Firebase CLI. Deploy with `firebase deploy --only hosting` and always run `firebase emulators:start` before testing rules.

---
description: React component style
globs: src/**/*.tsx
alwaysApply: false
---
Use function components with hooks. Name files in PascalCase. Keep components under 200 lines.
